scenes.title: Guess what we have been doing!
scenes.practice: Peppa asks Daddy to guess; two wrong guesses lead to the muddy-puddle answer.

lines.speaker: Peppa
lines.text: Daddy, Daddy! Guess what we've been doing!
lines.hint: 爸爸，爸爸！猜猜我们干什么了！

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Let me think. Have you been watching television?
lines.hint: 让我想想。你们在看电视吗？

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Have you just had a bath?

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: I know! You've been jumping in muddy puddles!
lines.hint: 我知道了！你们在泥坑里跳来跳去！

lines.speaker: Peppa
lines.text: Yes, yes, Daddy! We've been jumping in muddy puddles!
lines.hint: 对，对，爸爸！我们在泥坑里跳来跳去！

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Present-perfect guessing questions and long replies.

scenes.title: Can the patient have a visitor?
scenes.practice: Daddy checks on George and discovers the children’s pretend hospital, complete with cookie medicine.

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Oh no! What's wrong with George?

lines.speaker: Peppa
lines.text: Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game.
lines.hint: 别担心，爸爸。我们只是在玩游戏。

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Oh, I see. Can the patient have a visitor?
lines.hint: 哦，我明白了。病人可以有访客吗？

lines.speaker: Peppa
lines.text: Just for a little while. He might get tired.
lines.hint: 只能一小会儿。他可能会累的。

lines.speaker: Mummy Pig
lines.text: Yes, they're for George. They're his medicine to make him feel better.
lines.hint: 对，给乔治的。这是让他好起来的药。

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Patient, visitor and medicine vocabulary plus modal and conditional language.

scenes.title: Can we help find your glasses?
scenes.practice: The family offers to help Daddy find his glasses, and he insists he is not grumpy.

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Somebody must have put my glasses somewhere.
lines.hint: 一定有人把我的眼镜放到什么地方了。

lines.speaker: Mummy Pig
lines.text: Do you remember where you last put them, Daddy Pig?
lines.hint: 猪爸爸，你记得上次把眼镜放在哪里了吗？

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: When I don't wear them, I always put them in my pocket. But they aren't there now.
lines.hint: 不戴的时候，我总把眼镜放在口袋里。可是现在不在里面。

lines.speaker: Peppa
lines.text: Daddy, can we help find your glasses?
lines.hint: 爸爸，我们帮你找眼镜好吗？

lines.speaker: Mummy Pig
lines.text: Good idea, Peppa. If you find them, Daddy will stop being so grumpy.
lines.hint: 好主意，佩奇。找到眼镜，爸爸就不会这么暴躁了。

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Long clauses, remembering earlier events, and grumpy/conditional language.

scenes.title: You were sitting on them!
scenes.practice: Mummy reveals where the glasses were; Peppa teases Daddy, who cannot explain it.

lines.speaker: Mummy Pig
lines.text: Daddy Pig, you were sitting on them all the time!
lines.hint: 猪爸爸，你一直坐在眼镜上！

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: I don't know how they got there.
lines.hint: 我不知道眼镜怎么跑到那里了。

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Past-continuous phrasing and an implied joke.

scenes.title: Can I play with Ben?
scenes.practice: Holly asks to play, promises to practise later, and runs off as Nanny gives permission.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: But Nanny Plum, I was going to play with Ben.
lines.hint: 可是梅姨，我本来打算和本一起玩。

lines.speaker: Nanny Plum
lines.text: Princess Holly, there's a time for playing with elves and a time for wand practice.
lines.hint: 霍莉公主，和精灵玩有玩的时间，练习魔法棒有练习的时间。

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Please, Nanny. I promise to practise later.
lines.hint: 求你了，梅姨。我保证待会儿练习。

lines.speaker: Nanny Plum
lines.text: Hmm, very well, but come in when I—
lines.hint: 嗯，好吧，不过等我叫你时就——

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Promises, tense changes, and a longer adult explanation.

scenes.title: Elves are never scared!
scenes.practice: Ben claims he was not scared, then quickly leaves when Holly offers to try the magic again.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I'm an elf. Elves are never scared.
lines.hint: 我是精灵。精灵从来不害怕。

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Er, good. In that case, can I try again?
lines.hint: 呃，那就好。那我可以再试一次吗？

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.beginnerReviewReason: Scared, fantasy identity, and the idiom in that case.

scenes.title: How do I look?
scenes.practice: A magic hat turns Ben blue; everyone agrees his old hat is better, and Nanny restores it.

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: Oh no! The magic hat has turned Ben blue!
lines.hint: 哦，不！魔法帽把本变蓝了！

lines.speaker: Nanny Plum
lines.text: Um, I think your old hat suits you better.
lines.hint: 嗯，我觉得你原来的帽子更适合你。

lines.speaker: Nanny Plum
lines.hint: 阿布拉卡佐波迪！（剧中的魔法咒语）

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Ah, it's good to have my old hat back again.
lines.hint: 啊，能重新戴上我的旧帽子真好。

lines.speaker: Holly
lines.text: And it's nice to have you back, wand. I will never lose you again.
lines.hint: 魔法棒，你也回来了，真好。我再也不会把你弄丢了。

wordTiming.method: CTC forced alignment

scenes.title: Can we have some real coins?
scenes.titleZh: 能给我们几个真硬币吗？

lines.speaker: Bandit
lines.text: This machine doesn't take imaginary coins. Go and get a job and earn real ones.
lines.hint: 这台机器不收想象出来的硬币。去干点活，挣几个真的吧。

lines.speaker: Bluey
lines.text: Mum, can we have some real coins?
lines.hint: 妈妈，能给我们几个真硬币吗？

lines.speaker: Bandit
lines.text: I said go and get a job.

lines.speaker: Chilli
lines.text: Well, if you kids make Mum and Dad's bed, I'll give you twenty cents.
lines.hint: 好吧，你们把爸爸妈妈的床铺好，我就给你们二十分钱。

lines.speaker: Chilli
lines.hint: 我盯着你呢，魔法抓娃娃机。

scenes.summary: The children need coins for Dad’s pretend claw machine; Mum offers a small household job.
scenes.practice: Polite requests, imaginary versus real, and an if/then offer.
scenes.contentNotes: Pretend machine and household pocket-money bargain; not an invitation for young children to take outside work. Original Australian English.

scenes.title: That pancake went too high!

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: The secret of making a good pancake is to flip it high into the air.
lines.hint: 做出好煎饼的秘诀，就是把它高高地翻到空中。

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: Oh, maybe that was just a bit too high.
lines.hint: 哦，可能刚才翻得有点太高了。

lines.speaker: Mummy Pig
lines.text: Oh, what a shame. That was the last pancake.
lines.hint: 哦，真可惜，那是最后一张煎饼了。

lines.speaker: Daddy Pig
lines.text: It should be a simple matter to get it down.
